description.value: The Belmont is a combined pub and liquor store in Prince Rupert, a key North Coast hub for cyclists beginning or ending ferry journeys to Haida Gwaii or Alaska. The store advertises cold beer sold at government liquor store prices. Prince Rupert is a notable waypoint on remote northern touring routes, making a liquor resupply stop potentially relevant to multi-day cyclists.

address.value: 725 3rd Ave West, Prince Rupert, BC V8J 1M7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business as 'The Belmont Pub & Liquor Store' at 725 3rd Ave West, Prince Rupert, BC, with phone 250 624 4118 — these details are absent from OSM tags and are sourced entirely from the website. The OSM check_date of 2024-06-12 provides the most reliable open-status signal; the website itself is built on uCoz and has had no substantive content since 2013–2017, with the guestbook and forum overrun by spam. No cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'The Belmont Liquor Store' but the website consistently names it 'The Belmont Pub & Liquour Store' (also note the website misspells 'Liquour' and 'Goverment').

Website is extremely outdated — last substantive content dates to 2013 (photos) and 2015–2017 (forum/guestbook). The platform (uCoz) auto-generates a 2026 copyright date, which does not indicate active maintenance.
Guestbook and forum are overrun with spam (Indian packers-and-movers links from 2016), suggesting the site is unmonitored.
OSM record has no address, phone, or email tags — all contact info sourced solely from the website and cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
No cyclist amenity information available from any source; all required criteria are unverifiable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business appears to still exist (OSM check_date June 2024), but the website is essentially abandoned since ~2013–2017 and provides no cyclist amenity evidence. A liquor store/pub could be a useful resupply stop on a remote northern route, but needs on-the-ground verification of bike parking, washrooms, and current operating status before inclusion.
